limitations: Purpose relations (purpose_a_qualifying_invoice, purpose_b_required_link, purpose_c_commercial_dependency) are classified but not materialized in 06_world/world.sqlite per admission policy.
invoice_contract_link vocabulary allows only LINKED and UNRESOLVED; no negative link disposition was resolved in 05_dispositions.json.
legal_entity_identity pairs in 05_dispositions.json resolved only to SAME_ENTITY or UNRESOLVED; no DISTINCT judgments were admitted.
counterparty_identifier completeness receipt uses source_crm_account as universe anchor; full cross-source coverage is asserted in basis text rather than a dedicated union universe relation.

relations.name: source_invoice
relations.reason: Verbatim billing records keyed by source invoice_id are factual source observations independent of any analytical purpose.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each invoice tuple would still denote the same billed amount, period, status, and billed name drawn from sources/billing/invoices.json.

relations.name: source_crm_account
relations.reason: CRM account rows copied from sources/crm.csv are mechanical source facts, not purpose-scoped judgments.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each CRM account tuple would still represent the same account_name, domain, and crm_account_id from the CRM export.

relations.name: source_registry_company
relations.reason: Registry company rows are authoritative registry observations keyed by company_number.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each registry tuple would still state the same legal_name, jurisdiction, and status from sources/company_registry.csv.

relations.name: source_contract
relations.reason: Contract header metadata and counterparty name as stated in each contract file are source-document facts.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each contract tuple would still report the same effective_date, term_text, and counterparty_name_as_stated from the contract markdown header.

relations.name: contract_clause_excerpt
relations.reason: Verbatim clause excerpts are mechanical extractions of contract text spans, not acquisition-relevance classifications.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each excerpt tuple would still quote the same heading and body text from the named contract section.

relations.name: legal_name_normalization
relations.reason: Legal-suffix and punctuation normalization is a deterministic mechanical transform with no purpose policy or threshold.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each raw_name would still map to the same normalized_name under the fixed normalization rules.

relations.name: contract_lifecycle_status
relations.reason: Whether a contract is active or expired on the evaluation date is a factual lifecycle judgment grounded in contract dates and term mechanics, not in acquisition-relevance policy.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, ACTIVE versus EXPIRED would still be decided from the same effective dates, expiry statements, and renewal language in sources.

relations.name: contract_term_reading
relations.reason: PRESENT/ABSENT/UNRESOLVED readings for named clause families describe what the contract text asserts, without collapsing into purpose-specific acquisition-relevance labels.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each (contract, term_kind) reading would still mean the same presence or absence of that clause family in the contract text.

relations.name: legal_entity_identity
relations.reason: Pairwise same-entity judgments across CRM, billing, registry, and contract records are reusable counterparty facts grounded in names, registry numbers, and authoritative notes.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, SAME_ENTITY versus UNRESOLVED for a given record pair would still be supported by the same identity evidence in sources.

relations.name: invoice_contract_link
relations.reason: Invoice-to-contract linkage based on counterparty identity and stated commercial relationships is a factual governance tie, distinct from purpose A association labeling.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, LINKED versus UNRESOLVED for an invoice-contract pair would still reflect the same identity and relationship evidence without applying purpose confidence thresholds.

relations.name: invoice_open
relations.reason: Open versus closed status is mechanically derived from source_invoice.status with no purpose policy.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, is_open would still be true exactly when the source invoice status equals open.

relations.name: active_contract
relations.reason: The set of contracts with lifecycle disposition ACTIVE is a direct projection of contract_lifecycle_status, reusable beyond any single purpose gate.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, a contract would still appear in active_contract exactly when contract_lifecycle_status.disposition is ACTIVE.

relations.name: counterparty_identifier
relations.reason: Deterministic crm:/billing:/registry:/contract: identifier strings are canonical record keys derived from source-native keys, not purpose-B epistemic policy.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each source record would still map to the same prefixed identifier string from its native key fields.

relations.name: purpose_a_qualifying_invoice
relations.reason: Qualifying-invoice selection and association asserted versus unresolved labels depend on purpose A acquisition-relevant term families and association confidence policy.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purpose A disappeared, there would be no independent meaning for acquisition-relevant exposure labeling or the asserted/unresolved association threshold applied to invoice_contract_link.

relations.name: purpose_b_required_link
relations.reason: Required-link rows apply purpose B epistemic policy over commercially relevant pairs, copying legal_entity_identity only when purpose confidence rules permit.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purpose B disappeared, the epistemic column would lose its policy-defined meaning even though underlying legal_entity_identity judgments remain in World.

relations.name: purpose_c_commercial_dependency
relations.reason: Dependent versus unresolved status applies purpose C conjunctive definition over open invoices, continuing contracts, obligation kinds, and confident identity joins.
relations.purpose_independence_test: If purpose C disappeared, the dependent/unresolved status label would have no truth conditions independent of the purpose C conjunctive policy.
